headword: {猿|さる}も{木|き}から{落|お}ちる
gloss: even monkeys fall from trees; even experts make mistakes

definitions.explanation: A proverb meaning that even those who are skilled or experienced can make errors. Comparable to 'even Homer nods' or 'nobody's perfect.'

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{猿|さる}も{木|き}から{落|お}ちる⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I can't believe that master made a mistake. Even monkeys fall from trees, I guess.

examples.japanese: {猿|さる}も{木|き}から{落|お}ちる⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As they say, even monkeys fall from trees, so don't let your guard down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦でも→でも：noentry⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。{猿|さる}も{木|き}から{落|お}ちる⟦もの→もの：10988_mono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Even she makes mistakes sometimes. Nobody's perfect.

notes:
PROVERB MEANING:
Monkeys are known for their agility in climbing trees, yet even they sometimes fall. By extension, even the most skilled people can make mistakes.

USAGE:
Used to comfort someone who has made an unexpected error, or as a reminder to stay humble and not be overconfident.

GRAMMAR NOTES:
Often used with ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ or というように when citing the proverb.

RELATED PROVERBS:

- ⟦{河童|かっぱ}の{川流|かわなが}れ→河童の川流れ：29267_kappanokawanagare⟧: Even kappa (water creatures) can be swept away

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
- Even Homer nods
- Nobody's perfect
- To err is human
